text:
Maya (CS): Quick heads-up — overnight rollforward caused delayed embedding updates for a subset of EU dedicated tenants. Some customers reported stale search results and slower indexing. I opened tickets for affected accounts.

Ravi (SRE): Yup, we're investigating. Initial signal: indexer backlog + config change decreased concurrency for the embed rewriter job. Looks like a deploy set worker_count=1 by mistake.

Sam (Eng): Confirmed — the rollout injected an outdated deployment manifest to the reindexer service. Worker pool shrank, queue growth > retention, then eviction of pending jobs. Impact window ~00:42–01:10 UTC.

Liam (Support): Logged impacted tenants and ticket IDs: T-1142, T-1189, T-1193. Reached out with a short status note earlier. Customers asking ETA and whether data lost.

Ravi (SRE): No data loss. Jobs were queued and then reprocessed after we reverted the manifest. Root cause: CI pipeline using stale helm value during canary. We'll include the exact steps in the RCA.

Maya (CS): Ok — main asks for comms: 1) a concise status update for affected customers; 2) an explicit RCA summary for higher-touch accounts; 3) credits/comp offer and an invite to a live troubleshooting office hour.

Sam (Eng): Draft status blurb (short):
```
Hi — we experienced delayed embedding updates for a small group of EU tenants between 00:42–01:10 UTC due to an inadvertent configuration change during a deploy. The issue has been reverted and backfill is complete for all known impacted tenants. No customer data was lost. We ran prioritized reindexing and verified freshness — please reply if you see remaining discrepancies. — Redwood Inference Operations
```

Maya (CS): perfect. Can we also produce a slightly expanded RCA for enterprise customers with timeline + mitigation steps?

Ravi (SRE): Short RCA bullets we can reuse: 1) What: indexer concurrency set too low during rollforward; 2) Why: CI/helm template used stale value due to a pipeline cache miss; 3) Impact: delayed embedding updates for subset of EU dedicated tenants for ~28m; 4) Mitigation: rollback manifest, prioritized backfill, monitoring alert rule added; 5) Prevent: pipeline cache validation, gating deploy if indexer queue > threshold, add canary smoke for embed freshness.

Liam (Support): Customer-facing credit suggestion: 10% monthly credit + free 2-hour onboarding/ops session for high-touch customers. Thoughts? :money_with_wings:

Maya (CS): Good starting point. For top 10 impacted accounts, offer the session and a tailored exec note. For smaller tenants, send the short status + 5% one-time credit. I'll draft templates.

Sam (Eng): Scheduled an office hour for Thursday 14:00 UTC to walk through any anomalies and confirm reindexing. I'll post a calendar invite after we finalize the attendee list. @Maya (CS) can you assemble the list by EOD?

Maya (CS): Yep — assembling now. Planning two slots: 14:00 UTC (general) + 16:00 UTC (high-touch private sync).

Liam (Support): I'll send the short status note to all open tickets now. Copying the team on the email template.

DeployBot: Deployment rollback to previous manifest completed at 01:18 UTC — all services reporting healthy. :white_check_mark:

Maya (CS): Drafted HQ email for execs (paste here for quick review):
```
Subject: Incident summary — embedding update (EU)

Hi [Name],

We experienced a temporary delay in embedding updates for your tenant between 00:42–01:10 UTC due to an unintentional configuration change during a routine deployment. We reverted the change and prioritized reindexing; fresh embedding vectors are now in place. No customer data was lost.

Actions we took:
- Reverted faulty manifest and rolled forward a validated deploy
- Prioritized backfill for impacted tenants
- Added monitoring + alert thresholds on indexer queue depth
- Implemented CI pipeline validation to avoid stale helm values

We'd like to offer a complimentary 2-hour ops review and a one-time service credit as a gesture of apology. Please reply to schedule.

Best,
Maya & Ops
```

Sam (Eng): Good. Minor edit: change "rolled forward a validated deploy" -> "applied a validated rollback and re-deploy" for accuracy.

Maya (CS): Updated. Final checklist before send: 1) confirm impacted account list (Maya) 2) verify reindex complete for each tenant (Sam/Ravi) 3) support ticket updates sent (Liam) 4) schedule office hours and include calendar link (Sam).

Ravi (SRE): Reindex status: all known queues drained as of 01:25 UTC. I'll attach reindex job IDs to tickets.

Liam (Support): Status notes posted to tickets. Sending short status email now.

Maya (CS): Thanks team. I'll send the customer comms at 10:00 UTC with the short blurb and exec template for high-touch accounts. Please flag anything missing before 09:50 UTC.

Sam (Eng): Adding follow-up action to product: we should consider a deploy-time smoke test for embed freshness. @Product please track.

Maya (CS): Also asking customers for feedback post-office hour. Simple survey link to capture satisfaction and any lingering issues.

Liam (Support): Copy of sent message pasted here for audit: "We've identified and resolved an issue that delayed embedding updates; reindexing complete; no data lost; contact us if you see issues."

Maya (CS): Closing loop — will post final sent copy + attendee list after send. Thanks all. :pray:
